title: WARNER CHAPPELL’S CARIANNE MARSHALL LEAVES COO/CO-CHAIR ROLE AFTER TRANSFORMATIVE SEVEN-YEAR TENURE
summary: Warner Music Group (Nasdaq: WMG) today announced that Carianne Marshall will transition out of her. . .
body_markdown:
[Warner Music Group](https://www.wmg.com/) (Nasdaq: WMG) today announced that **Carianne Marshall** will transition out of her role as Co-Chair and Chief Operating Officer of Warner Chappell Music (WCM), the global music publishing arm of WMG, at the end of this month, as the company streamlines its leadership structure.


WCM CEO **Guy Moot** will become the sole chair of WCM, effective October 1. Marshall will remain with the company through the end of the calendar year to ensure a seamless transition.


Marshall joined WCM in June 2018 and has co-led the publisher alongside Moot since April 2019. She has played a key role in a transformative time for the company, modernizing digital licensing, driving exponential growth and expanding a genre-diverse roster of established and emerging talent alongside a rich catalog of songs. Among many highlights, Marshall introduced WCM’s pioneering Creative Services department to amplify commercial and creative opportunities for songwriters, while building a culture that fosters curiosity, collaboration and commitment in service of championing songwriters at every stage of their careers.


Robert Kyncl said: “Carianne has been instrumental in building Warner Chappell into the successful company it is today. She’s helped drive exceptional results that have set our songwriters and our business up for long-lasting success. Our talented team will build upon the incredible foundation she’s put in place. We thank her for her dedication, impact and wish her the very best in her next chapter.”


Carianne Marshall said: “When Guy and I began this journey together, we wanted to build a songwriter-first home for the creative community. Reflecting on our time, I am proudest not only of our growth, but of the incredible culture and values we’ve fostered together. I step away with immense gratitude for Len, Robert, Guy, the WMG Board, and our entire Warner Chappell team knowing that the company has never been better positioned for what’s next.”


Guy Moot said: “Carianne has been an extraordinary partner and a fierce champion for our songwriters and our people over the past seven years. Her vision, heart and drive helped us establish an operating foundation that sets Warner Chappell apart and shaped a winning global team. I am deeply grateful for our partnership and wish her every happiness.”
